nom: Hero Cosmetics Mighty Shield Invisible Blemish Protectant

segments.oily: The one reviewer who states she has oily skin — despite the product's own labeling suggesting it works best on combination to dry skin — reports it worked great for her.
segments.dry: The one reviewer with dry skin found the product can look cracked or obvious unless she preps with a hydrating toner and emollient moisturizer first, and recommends using only a small amount.

concerns.dehydration: A couple of reviewers specifically note the product does not dry out their skin, though the one reviewer with dry skin found it can look cracked or obvious unless she first preps with a hydrating toner and moisturizer.
concerns.redness: A few reviewers report brief stinging or burning when applying the product to a freshly picked or already-irritated blemish, which fades quickly and does not appear to cause visible redness or lasting irritation; most others report no irritation at all.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report the product protects active blemishes from dirt, bacteria, and picking, and several specifically say their blemishes healed faster, shrank, or cleared up with consistent use; a few say it clearly worked as a physical barrier but couldn't confirm any speed-of-healing benefit since they don't get many blemishes to test it on. The main complaint is about wear rather than efficacy: several reviewers found the patch peeled, pilled, or lifted at the edges within a few hours, especially around the mouth, nose, or under makeup.
concerns.oiliness: The one reviewer who mentions oil control says the formula's salicylic acid helps unclog pores and reduce oiliness in addition to concealing the blemish.

aspects.libelle: Peels or flakes at the edges over time
Dries clear and invisible in under a minute
Shiny finish, obvious without makeup on top
Strong alcohol smell while wet, fades once dry
Learning curve to apply a thin, even layer

extraits.texte: I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. Hero Mighty Shield Invisible Blemish Protectant works great! It is a liquid gel that drys to a smooth, clear patch . It creates an invisible barrier that protects your blemishes under makeup and sunscreen. I also use it alone and it is completely invisible. I love how easy it is to apply and it stays on all day until you remove it. Apply a thin layer to blemish and let it dry completely, then continue with skincare & makeup. Remove in 6 - 8 hours, lift edge & peel off, then use cleanser. It says it works best on combination to dry skin, but I have oily skin and it works great. I would recommend! #ad

I read some reviews before I purchased this and people were pointing out that you can see the patch under makup. The first time or two I used it I also had the same problem but after consistently using it for a few weeks now, I have figured out that for best results squeeze out a little onto the applicator and use that amount for your whole face. It doesn't take a whole lot. I think it gets cakey when you apply too much in one area. Also, for dry skin (like myself) hydrating skin prep also helps not make it look cracked and gross. So a milky toner and an emollient moisturizer.

extraits.titre: Love the idea, but doesn't work
extraits.texte: I thought the idea of this product was really great and innovative, but the execution was not good. It peels very easily without any products layered on top and it's even worse with makeup on top. Don't waste your money.

extraits.titre: Don't listen to the negative comments, use own judgement
extraits.texte: Is this product perfect? No. But does it work. Yes. You absolutely have to use it as intended though, right after a cleanse with a bare, dry face. Then follow up with skincare. If not it will just peel around the edges, won't lay right under makeup at all, and look terrible like most of the 1 star reviews said that almost dissuaded me from purchasing. Once I used it as the instructions on the box advised I was confused on what they were talking about and realized they probably put it on after their skincare routine like I foolishly did the first time as for similar results. It will begin to peel towards the end of the day even if applied properly, but you get a lot of use before then. Once it begins to peel makeup buffs out on the spot left behind easily, even just with a fingertip in the bathroom mirror. If your struggling with acne bad and trying to look for a solution to keep wearing makeup while hopefully helping your skin get better, i really reccomend. When your dealing with really bad acne it can ruin your confidence. Makeup doesnt lay or look right, you feel exposed or ugly without it. This helps you to feel better about wearing makeup overtop of acne, ive found sometimes it lays smoother too. Not always, but if your acne already looks a little cakey under makeup whats the difference. If you keep your expectations realistic and use as instructed i would reccomend this product and since using my acne has gotten better and i stopped using for awhile because of it. Truly

[This review was collected as part of a promotion.] I'm usually on the go, so I love using products that are convenient and easy to use. Mighty Shield Invisible Blemish Protectant is perfect for these occasions, so I like to add this in my bag and take it to Work or to the gym. They're also my go-tos when I have my monthly hormonal breakouts, and the fact that they are clear is great because it allows for easy application of other products, such as makeup or my everyday skincare. What's even better is that it not only conceals your blemishes but also helps unclog your pores, reduces oiliness, and calms inflammation with the help of salicylic acid. If you don't already own Mighty Shield Invisible Blemish Protectant, I would highly recommend it, especially these!!!

extraits.titre: Love the idea, not quite there for me though
extraits.texte: I received this product for free for the purpose of my review. All opinions are my own. I really like the idea of a liquid pimple patch, anything to keep me from picking at my skin, however, this one is quite there for me. Application is super easy, but because it is basically just something to keep it covered (and is mostly alcohol for quick drying) it can burn on something that has recently been picked. Its a little uncomfortable but goes away quickly. The product dries incredibly quickly, but I've found that if you're applying it somewhere that creases a lot (near the mouth as an example) it can start to peel up before you're ready for it. Personally, this makes me not want to wear it under makeup, even though you definitely can. So I'm sticking to using this on no makeup days, when I'm home, or just doing a quick run into town so I don't have to worry about it coming up.

extraits.titre: This Will Be A Daily Use Product For Sure!
extraits.texte: I received this product for free for the purpose of my review. All opinions are my own. So I have only used it twice so far but this blemish protectant is great. It doesn't replace pimple patches entirely, but I have been using it on my inflamed and popped acne for work. My coworker swears she can't even tell I'm wearing it. It's stopped me from touching my face 100% and stops anything from like bleeding or oozing. It says you can wear it under makeup and skincare but I have to be extra gentle when applying moisturizer or it'll start to peel up the edges. I tried under some super light color corrector today and it was a bit too dry but I'm sure if I wanted to do full makeup application I could make it work. I really like the idea of wearing it as a base so my skin doesn't react to the makeup! Usually my acne will flair up if I wear too much makeup so it seems like a really good solution. I have had 0 negative reactions to it which is usually my concern with new products. I think it's perfect for me to skip pimple patches during the day at least! I have full intentions of making this a daily use product for me.
